scope: First native rack-editor slice: SMLib rack blank, persistent wgpu viewport, face selection, dimension editing and OpenCascade print exports.

environment.window_test: X11 under Xvfb; native input events and inspected screenshots
environment.kernel_build: Release, TBB enabled; serialized public API calls

benchmark.workload: default rack blank, identical ordered box unions; OCCT clean included
benchmark.method: Seven paired native builds; discard first, median of remaining six. Both native kernels built in release mode. Tessellation, audit, and exact-volume verification excluded from build timings and recorded separately for SMLib. OCCT clean included. Run after compilation and UI interactions completed.
benchmark.limits: One planar box-union rack blank. Does not characterize curves, fillets, large assemblies, GPU frame time, or input latency.

regressions: All cavity shells included with finite-void winding correction
Mesh volume agrees with exact SMLib body and OCCT reference

ui_checks.name: native window rendered with cached mesh
dimension edit rebuilds and uploads once
clearance-only edit reuses geometry and GPU buffers
invalid edit retains previous mesh without uploading
face picking and highlighting reuse GPU buffers
orbit reuses geometry and GPU buffers
pan and zoom reuse geometry and GPU buffers
native export action writes seventeen STEP/STL files

limitations: Viewport displays unsplit rack blank; printing export generates joints using OpenCascade.
Native joint clearance is fixed at 0.2 mm.
Native project persistence, sketches, edge editing and feature history are not implemented.
Physical joint fit, load capacity and hinge clearance require print trials.
